newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch post Dfl 2.5 billion Feb trade surplus.
newsitem.headline: Dutch post Dfl 2.5 billion Feb trade surplus.

text.p: The Dutch trade surplus narrowed to a provisional 2.5 billion guilders in February 1997 from 3.6 billion in January, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said.
In February 1996 the trade surplus was 2.6 billion guilders, the CBS said.
DUTCH TRADE BALANCE Febr 97 Jan 97 Febr 96
NOTE - Merchandise trade in billions of guilders.
The CBS said imports grew strongly in February, by more than 9 percent compared to the same month last year to almost 27 billion guilders. In January imports increased by 5 percent.
The CBS said imports from the UK grew by over 14 percent in February compared to February 1996, with imports of fuel and cars increasing substantionally.
The CBS said the pound sterling rose by 20 percent against the guilder in February 1997 compared to February 1996.
The increase in exports was most strong to Italy and the UK, increasing by 28 and 15 percent respectively.
The CBS said the lira rose by 9 percent against the guilder in February 1997 compared to February 1996.
